description_en: Queries the type of a sensitive data identification rule
description_zh: 调用QueryRecognizeDataByRuleType接口获取数据保护伞的敏感字段识别方式列表
name: QueryRecognizeDataByRuleType

parameters.help_en:
The type of a sensitive data identification rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746905.html operation to obtain the type of the rule.

*   1: regular expression
*   2: built-in rule
*   3: sample library
*   4: self-generated data identification model
parameters.help_zh:
识别规则类型。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746905.html接口获取规则的类型。
- 1：正则表达式
- 2：内置模型
- 3：样本库
- 4：自生成模型
parameters.name: recognize_rules_type

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). Find your workspace and go to the DataStudio page. On the DataStudio page, click the logon username in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id
